method: Code Doctor evidence-first diagnosis; independent WB/Ozon source review; Taste app-screen and Impeccable Operate/native review of existing JavaFX status/report surface. Not a full security/application audit.
checks: WB incremental, recovery and GTIN source scans do not terminate on short nonempty pages.
Ozon totals/cursors/membership are validated; missing totals require empty-tail proof, exact known final totals permit a blank final cursor.
WB full detail refresh uses one bounded fresh selected-card scan, isolates card-specific errors, propagates cancellation/account/global scan failures, and persists successful snapshots once.
UI separates product-list count from detail success/failure; safe localized failure records avoid raw exceptions and stale owner results.
WB overall approval cannot manufacture a verified document; current owned live snapshot plus an individually valid current document is required.
WB verdict types and known codes are strict; Ozon four status examples have pinned mirror provenance and unknown codes never grant approval.
Ozon fresh declined status is checked before document binding.
Ozon malformed paper collections, entries, IDs, page counts and contradictory dates throw before persistence; previous valid snapshots survive.
Ozon full ISO date/date-time parsing rejects suffix garbage; no broad catch swallows owner/security changes.
No schema/dependency/version/production credentials or publication changes.
limits: Live Ozon read blocked by configured test credential HTTP403/code7; contract mirrors are not a seller acceptance test.
Live WB isolated read does not prove the exact cached profile or store in the screenshot, nor Windows seller UI.
Normal Ozon non-registration resume still uses existing cache membership when no persisted scan count exists; explicit refresh starts from the beginning.
UI tested at720px in current fixture locale; not all themes/locales/NVDA/Windows DPI were visually exercised.
Impeccable context reports unsupported JavaFX platform classification/stale sidecar/update available; these unrelated artifacts were not changed.
